reuse.why: Takes its categories from the shared getMonthWideCategories and uses getSheetValue/setBudget/batchMessages and mutator(undoable), but re-inlines the income guard and sign flip as its siblings do.

duplication.why: The `is_income === 1 && !isTrackingBudget()` skip and the expense sign flip are copied once more from setZero/set3MonthAvg rather than shared.

placement.why: Defined in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and registered alongside them in app.ts.

scope.why: Only the action, its registration and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small and consistent with its siblings; the per-action income and sign logic is the existing pattern, now with one more copy.

disguised_duplication.where: The income guard and sign flip are open copies of the sibling pattern.
